answer_1.quote: We propose the novel problem of end-to-end learning of a TOD system that troubleshoots user's problems by using a flowchart and a corpus of FAQs.

answer_2.quote: We measure the ability to generate responses using two standard metrics: BLEU and perplexity.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation for the responses generated by FLONET and 3 other variants of FLONET along two dimensions: (i) relevance—the ability to generate responses that are relevant to the dialog context, and (ii) grammar—ability to generate grammatically correct and fluent responses.
answer_4.guideline: relevance and grammar evaluated on a Likert scale (0-4)
